g4-disposition-lessons.title: Migrate every active lesson into an episode -- nothing is lost and nothing is judged
g4-disposition-lessons.imperative: REASONING GATE (crew waived: this is transcription of 20 lesson records this Commander has read in full, under a non-fabrication rule a fresh crew would have to be taught from scratch; the risk being managed here is invented content, and a crew maximizes it). MIGRATE every entry in LESSONS.md's Active section into an episode via scripts/apply_episode_delta.py. A lesson ALREADY IS an observation -- what happened plus how someone worked around it. Migrate it; do NOT judge it. NO graduation to docs/agents/, NO doctrine lines, NO deletion: deletion survives only as merging a genuine duplicate, and a merge MUST preserve the recurrence signal because two records of one thing are evidence of frequency. Record what is KNOWN and mark what is not as UNKNOWN IN-FIELD. NEVER back-fill a plausible-sounding observed-behavior to satisfy a required field (#342) -- an explicit 'unknown' naming the source lesson is a record; an invented incident is a corruption. Where a lesson already carries a severity or cause claim, carry it VERBATIM AND ATTRIBUTED inside the five agent-supplied statements; do NOT promote it into the diagnosis bin, because suspected-cause/proposed-remedy solicit the judgement by name. Each episode carries '- artifact-ref: lesson:<id>' as its provenance marker -- that marker is what c1 counts. THEN retire each migrated lesson through apply_lessons_delta.py with a reason naming the episode it became; never hand-edit LESSONS.md. Verify by READING BACK. Record in notes-308.md: the per-lesson migration table, the MIGRATION COUNT, and the NUMBER OF EPISODES CARRYING AN UNKNOWN FIELD -- those two numbers are this issue's deliverable, and the unknown count is a headline number, not a defect.

postconditions.statement: ZERO active lessons AND every id in the pre-migration snapshot is reachable in the episode store by its provenance marker -- both halves, because retirement alone is not migration and a count-to-zero check alone would be satisfied by deleting the file

postconditions.satisfied_by: notes-308.md carries the g4 section: the 23-row per-episode migration table (episode id, provenance marker, origin run, fields recorded UNKNOWN), the two deliverable numbers -- 23 migrated, 11 of 23 carrying at least one UNKNOWN field, 15 unknown fields total -- their distribution (expected-behavior 7, impact-cost 7, workaround 1, observed-behavior ZERO), the three schema facts that forced choices with the line numbers they were measured at, the two filed findings #399 and #400, and the record of migration_done.py going red against its own author. Every number in that section is derived by command over the store, not eyeballed.

postconditions.statement: full suite green

constraints: NEVER hand-edit LESSONS.md or an episode file; all writes via apply_lessons_delta.py / apply_episode_delta.py.

Never invent content to satisfy a required field; an honest in-field 'unknown' naming the source lesson is the only permitted filler, and any schema that refuses an honest gap gets FILED as a finding.
No graduation, no doctrine line, no deletion. A duplicate merges and preserves the recurrence signal.
Verify by reading back, not by having written.
